## ✨ Highlights

- **New agent: OpenClaw** — HarnessKit now manages [OpenClaw](https://openclaw.ai) as its 15th agent: skills across the managed directory and every agent workspace, MCP servers with install, removal and OpenClaw's native enable/disable, plus each workspace's rules and memory files. Hooks, plugins and remote MCP installs are left for a follow-up.
